feed.title: Ripple guides
feed.subtitle: Short guides from the developer of Ripple, a free app blocker for Android and iPhone, on phone limits for adults and for kids.

entry.title: Minimalist launcher or app blocker? Olauncher, minimalist phone and Ripple
entry.summary: A text only home screen like Olauncher hides icons. It does not stop you opening an app. What minimalist launchers do well, where they fall short on a child's phone, and how a free app blocker with daily limits fits next to one.

entry.title: A YourHour or Regain alternative without ads or Pro?
entry.summary: YourHour has ads and Pro plans, Regain puts strict mode and Pomodoro in Pro. What each does well, and what a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code someone else keeps can do instead.

entry.title: Looking for Jomo on Android, or a free Clearspace alternative?
entry.summary: Jomo is only on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Clearspace has you earn minutes with push-ups. What each costs, and what a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code someone else keeps can do instead.

entry.title: Brick or Unpluq, or a free app? Physical NFC phone blockers compared
entry.summary: What Brick and Unpluq do, what they cost and which phones they support, and when a free app blocker with an unlock code someone else keeps does the same job. For your own phone and for a child's phone.

entry.title: Living alone and scrolling every evening, or raising a child mostly on your own
entry.summary: How to limit video and game apps when you live alone and the phone takes every evening and weekend, and how to set limits on a child's phone when you look after them mostly by yourself. Calls and chats keep working.

entry.title: A hospital stay: scrolling in a hospital bed, staying overnight, and a child on the ward
entry.summary: How to limit video and game apps during a hospital stay while keeping calls, chats and hospital apps working. For patients, people staying overnight with family, and parents of a child in hospital.
